profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Amazon
profile.summary: I am a senior at Purdue University studying computer engineering in the College of Electrical and Computer Engineering with a minor in mathematics.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.locationName: West Lafayette, Indiana, United States · On-site
positions.description:
• Investigating the efficacy of LLM oriented approaches to analyze system software failures from historical media
• Streamlining article postmortem extraction, analysis, and knowledge organization to address industry challenges
• Evaluating prompt engineering techniques across varying temperature levels and optimizing for response accuracy

positions.title: Honors Engineering UTA ENGR 16X00
positions.description: Teaching students engineering approaches to systems using computational methods to support design decisions. Facilitating design challenges exploring a wide range of phenomena both experimentally and computationally. Reinforcing ideas in vector analysis, solid materials interactions, MATLAB, Python, and Raspberry Pi. Leading after class office hours and review sessions, offering homework and project assistance.

positions.title: ECE Student Society
positions.description:
* Website Development Chair
* ECE Ambassador
* ECESS Executive Board Secretary

positions.title: UTA ECE 20875 Python for Data Science
positions.description: Introduce Python programming to students through data science problems. This course includes bash scripting as well as python basics in order to implement higher order functions, map/reduce, regular expressions and basic text processing. The data science concepts covered include N-gram analysis, probability distributions, clustering, classifiers, perceptrons, and neural nets. Additionally, I am responsible for hosting office hours to assist students in assignments, as well as grading assignments and working with graduate staff.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Software Design · Software Industry · Engineering · Data Analysis · Software as a Service (SaaS) · Agile Methodologies

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
* Standardizing AWS/Azure Jenkins Core Pipelines, and migrating from Concourse to Jenkins Core
* Configuring and deploying highly available and scalable applications in Azure and AWS using EC2 RDS
* Developing persistent and transient CI/CD pipelines automating enterprise level cloud data migration services for databases for on premise, Maria DB, oracle and many other databases in the complex data automation space
* Building automated regression test suites for Oracle on EC2 using Python and Jenkins core to be executed for any instance of code change, bug fix, or new deployment
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · DevOps · Automated Regression Testing · Jenkins · Cloud Development
